title: Reading from a disk
text: So far every file was in memory. Now a disk: the same read, of a file on ext4 (on a disk). Where do the bytes come from the first time?
1. Opening it: the name is not in the dentry cache yet, so [ext4_lookup](ext4_lookup) reads the directory's block from the disk to find it.
Try: [read twice](try:1): the page is in the cache after the first read, so the second has no block layer and no ext4 read path in it: the timeline shows it much shorter.
